raw_text:
Senior Backend Engineer — FinTech Platform

Company: NorthStar Payments
Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)
Experience: 5+ years

About the Role:
We are building a next-generation payments platform serving millions of
transactions per day. We need a Senior Backend Engineer to lead the design
and implementation of our core transaction services.

Must Have:
- 5+ years of professional backend engineering experience
- Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI or Django)
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and query optimization
- Experience designing and consuming REST APIs
- Production experience with AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)
- Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
- Experience with payments, fintech, or high-throughput transaction systems
- Strong understanding of distributed systems and eventual consistency

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kubernetes and Helm
- Familiarity with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms
- Exposure to observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana)
- Prior experience leading a small engineering team
- Contributions to open-source projects

Responsibilities:
- Design and own microservices powering payment processing
- Mentor junior engineers and conduct code reviews
- Collaborate with product and compliance teams
- Drive reliability, latency, and cost improvements

What We Value:
- Evidence-driven engineering decisions
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Bias for action with high ownership
